body_generic.introduction_text: Students use smartphones in the classroom to support learning.
body_generic.body_text:
First, smartphones help students during classroom activities. For example, a teacher can ask students to look up a difficult word in an online dictionary. Students can read the meaning and explain it to their classmates. This gives them information they can use during the lesson.

Second, smartphones can help students practice lessons.
